d:
The female dorm in a local university caught fire last week leading to the deaths of 4 female college students between the ages of 20 and 23 from smoke inhalation. Even more tragically, the 26 year old, 7 months pregnant sister of one of the victims was visiting her at that time and also succumbed to the smoke. Her baby could not be saved either.

The following series is a tribute to the victims (who shall not be named out of respect and consideration to their grieving families) showing them alive and well 1 hour before the fire contrasting with how they looked when rescue personnel carried their limp and dead bodies out of the burning building later on.

Andersveg Productions would also like to take this opportunity to remind one and all to treasure your loved ones (and yourselves) as you never know the difference an hour can make.

Here are the 5 victims, showing them one hour before their deaths and then just after they died.
